name: Shatter
description:
Choose a point within medium range. You create an explosive concussion of force centered on that point.

Roll Lore vs Fortitude against each creature within short range of the point. On each win, the creature takes 1d8 damage. On each loss, half damage. Either way, if the creature is made inorganic material such as stone or metal, double the damage. Mundane objects within the area automatically take the damage. Magical objects within the area automatically take half damage.

Describe the sound.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: On each win, the creature is knocked prone and deafened for 1 minute.

💀: The explosion causes you to lose your hearing for 10 minutes.
